message: We've all been there — chatting in the family group text during a blackout, trying to remember what to do next. It can feel a bit chaotic, but it’s really just a chance to cozy up and share a little time together. I found a great resource that lays out some practical steps for handling power outages. It’s a good reminder that a little preparation can turn a dark moment into a fun family memory. How do you keep the good vibes going when the lights go out?
